name: list_directory
description: List files and subdirectories inside a workspace-relative path. Returns entries sorted with directories first, then files alphabetically. Call with path "." or omit path to list the workspace root.

detailed: Lists files and subdirectories in a workspace path.
whimsical: Take a peek inside the folder.
{source} is taking stock of the shelves

path.description: Workspace-relative directory path to list. Defaults to the workspace root.
